title: Official blog knowledge stage 8
summary: This iteration adds a reviewed authoring step for OpenAI and Anthropic official blog knowledge records. Approved intake entries with explicit Chinese authoring fields can now be normalized into schema-constrained curated records and written through a clean CLI without live fetching, automatic translation, public docs output, or queue diagnostic leakage.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "official blog author records|official blog knowledge drafts" tests/official-blog-knowledge.test.js tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: Curated official blog records need explicit reviewed authoring fields, not automatic promotion from intake previews.
lessons.evidence: Stage 8 requires reviewed include approval plus `title_zh`, `summary_zh`, `key_ideas`, `importance`, `content_type`, `topics`, and admission rationale before a record is produced.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep authoring inputs separate from preview ingestion and require reviewer-supplied Chinese synthesis before writing knowledge records.

lessons.lesson: Authoring output should be a curated schema record, not a review queue dump.
lessons.evidence: Stage 8 tests assert curated records omit `opening_preview`, `source_label`, `next_action`, body fields, and queue-only diagnostics while preserving canonical URL, topics, related blog ids, and report dates.
lessons.recommended_action: Use `knowledge/official-blogs/**` only for final curated records; keep queue artifacts in internal outputs.

lessons.lesson: Authoring must dedupe before writing files.
lessons.evidence: Stage 8 reports existing-knowledge URL duplicates and incomplete/unapproved entries as invalid instead of writing duplicate record files.
lessons.recommended_action: Preserve URL and id dedupe as the first authoring gate before adding richer related-link generation.

suggestions.issue: Approved official blog intake entries had no deterministic path into curated `knowledge/official-blogs/**` records.
suggestions.evidence: Stage 8 adds `createOfficialBlogKnowledgeDrafts`, CLI command `official-blog:author-records`, authoring-field validation, queue-internal field omission, duplicate rejection, clean `--output` summary behavior, and public-output path rejection.
suggestions.suggestion: Use reviewed authoring JSON as the bridge from intake queue entries into curated official blog knowledge records.
suggestions.expected_benefit: OpenAI and Anthropic blog knowledge can be expanded with durable Chinese summaries and graph links while keeping raw candidate diagnostics and full article text out of public artifacts.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented through deterministic authoring, CLI, and schema-loading tests.
validation_evidence: official blog knowledge drafts require reviewed authoring fields and omit queue internals
official blog author records CLI writes curated records and clean summary JSON
official blog author records CLI refuses public output paths

followups.action: Add relationship suggestions that compare a reviewed record's topics and matched criteria against existing official blog records before authoring.
Add optional live fetching only after it writes the Stage 7 preview feed artifact and remains separated from reviewed authoring.
